prompts.scene: Use case: illustration-story. Generate a completely NEW high-detail 16:9 landscape illustration for a fullscreen first-person inspection in a melancholic dark-fantasy game set in a miserable temperate marsh. The viewer crouches extremely close to an old massive twisted tree root. Beneath the arch of rotten wet wood is a narrow hand-sized hollow receding into unreadable darkness. In the opening, partially concealed by small roots, damp decomposing leaves and black peat, two or three small elongated ivory snake eggs can just be discerned, one clearer than the others. The hollow might contain a snake, or might be empty beyond the eggs: preserve terrifying uncertainty, no obvious snake head or eyes. Tangled thin roots deeper inside can resemble a curved animal body ambiguously. Claustrophobic low close-up, tactile bark, mud, water droplets, a tiny amount of swamp water near foreground. Horrifying through anticipation and natural decay, restrained and believable. Painterly realism with extremely crisp material detail, consistent with mature illustrated RPG backgrounds, NOT cartoon or 3D render. Cold diffuse overcast light barely reaches the eggs; desaturated slate grey, peat brown, black-green moss, pale dirty ivory. Keep the image legible, not uniformly black or muddy. Hollow and eggs in central upper-middle area; lower 18 percent remains quieter dark earth for a later interactive choice overlay. No people, no hands, no text, no buttons, no UI, no border, no gore. This scene precedes the choice whether to reach a hand into the root.
prompts.egg: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one isolated natural snake egg inventory artwork for a mature melancholic dark-fantasy RPG. Exactly ONE small elongated leathery reptile egg, subtly asymmetrical, off-white dirty ivory, faint wrinkles and slight soft indentation, finely textured matte flexible shell, a few damp brown peat traces adhered at the bottom. Entire intact egg visible, diagonally oriented with a clean readable silhouette, centered with generous transparent padding. Painterly realism, precise beautiful illustration, restrained cold natural highlights and warm grey shadows, detailed but not oversharpened, NOT a faceted gem or clay sculpture or chicken egg. No hatching, no cracks showing an animal, no snake, no nest, no foliage, no text, no frame, no ground plane, no opaque backdrop, no cast shadow outside silhouette. Genuine transparent PNG alpha background. Square composition. This egg visually belongs inside a damp rotting root hollow in a cold temperate swamp.
